usageNote: instead of就是'换成别的'的意思！instead of the hall就是'不在大厅，换个地方'，超实用的替代表达～

examples.en: We held the meeting in the classroom instead of the hall.
examples.zh: 我们在教室开会，而不是在大厅。

examples.en: She waited outside instead of the hall because it was too noisy.
examples.zh: 因为太吵了，她在外面等而不是在大厅里。
